transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we lock the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package, I need to go through our standard department-by-department signoff routine. I'd like to hear from rights, post-production, and publicity — please report any required changes to the current draft package before I give final approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag two required changes on the rights side. I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and it restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — so the worldwide delivery listed in the current draft package needs to be corrected. Additionally, the required credit is exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' which differs from the studio's standard music credit currently listed in the draft. I haven't entered these terms into the delivery tracker yet due to the rights database migration still being open, but these are the binding terms from the countersigned license.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag required changes on the post-production side. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today, and it confirms that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The current draft package lists a 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitles — those will fail the partner's ingest specification. I've kept the test result in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change on the publicity side. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the 'Midnight Arcade' special is embargoed until June 21. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21, so the June 14 publicity release date currently listed in the draft package needs to be corrected to June 21 or later. I should also note that the approval email is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, so I'll make sure it gets properly filed.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.music_credit: Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs

commitments.detail: Enter the corrected distribution territories (US and Canada only) and the required music credit into the delivery tracker once the rights database migration is complete.
Update the draft package master format to IMF package at 25 fps and caption format to English SDH captions based on the broadcaster's ingest test results.
Update the publicity release date to June 21 and ensure the approval email is properly filed in the delivery tracker.
